prompt:
Refine the supplied selected Physical Impact slide with exactly THREE COPY changes. This is the final selected visual family, not a new layout. Preserve the exact off-white/evergreen/mint DA, brand, large tagline, value line, secondary existing-tools note, four cards and their illustrations, all positions, WHO IT'S FOR, FIRST USERS, and existing verified-flow line. No variant badge. Crisp English, same 16:9 size.

CHANGE 1, main explanation below headline: replace the existing paragraph with exactly:
"An agent that knows your business and uses market intelligence to prepare a coordinated response before you ask. It executes the actions you approve."
Keep this paragraph in the existing centered supporting-copy area at the same readable body size. The key differentiator "before you ask" should be very clear in the text, without turning it into a separate giant headline or adding a banner. Natural line wrapping, minimal local adjustment if required.

CHANGE 2, description inside the second card "Sees what matters": replace only that paragraph with exactly:
"Monitors sector news, supply changes and new demand in the background to surface risks and opportunities."
Keep the heading and both Supply disruption / New demand illustrations unchanged. It must fit comfortably above the existing mini-UI, at the same body size as the other cards.

CHANGE 3, WHY NOW block at the bottom: replace only its paragraph with exactly:
"Market information is abundant. Agents can now connect it with company data and business tools, helping teams act before shortages stop production, deliveries or projects."
Keep the WHY NOW heading, footer column dimensions, same body size and readable natural line breaks. Preserve the WHO and FIRST USERS columns completely, including French multi-site materials businesses and the supply-planning pilot acquisition route.

The full received product vision remains: knows company, proactively prepares a coordinated response using market intelligence, human-approved action, verification and memory. Background preparation is complementary to the whole vision; it is not just a monitoring product. Existing tools/headless capability stays secondary. Do not add another section, statement, customer, statistic, pricing, logo or proof. Especially do not change the current verified-flow statement to claim that proactive preparation or real ERP execution was already demonstrated. This is three marketing-copy refinements only. No warning/disclaimer/test/demo labels. Everything else stays unchanged in layout and content.
